svg.title: Wakey walk cycle
svg.desc: Wakey walking to the left in place, from the Good morning pose (pic5), in face-rig units (head centre 150,184). Two steps per 1000 ms (CSS). The face runs on its own 23.4 s clock (SMIL): eyes neutral with random glances and blinks, or happy closed; mouth closed smile or open. Every limb is a chain of groups rotating around its pivot (walk-cycle.json). Generated by walk.mjs: change the tokens there, not this file.
